A national water utility — Energy & Utilities engagement delivered by a 13-person team over 12 months, EU scope, commercial model: build-transfer.

items: Leakage unlocated; district metering sparse; repairs reactive.
Field operations by phone; routing inefficient.

blocks.x: District metering fabric (flow/pressure/quality with governance) feeds leak-location analytics on Forge; work-order orchestration routes crews by skills and proximity; and the meter-to-bill pipeline with anomaly detection collapsed dispute volume.

The Achala Method shaped the program: baseline locked in a Value Mapping Sprint, capital-grade evidence from a gated PoC, and production hardening — replay, SLOs, control tests — generated by delivery, not reconstructed for auditors.
